text:
Aria (PM): Quick sync: Acme asked for private pilot with active-active across us-east/us-west + RTO <30s for regional failover. Need to reconcile infra/runtime/security constraints before we commit.
Noah (Eng): active-active adds state-sync requirements for KV cache. Runtime currently assumes single primary per-tenant. Changing that touches cache eviction and consistency.
Chen (Runtime): right. We can support eventual consistency with a TTL-based reconcile, but p95 will suffer on cross-region reads unless we serve from local cache. That implies warmup + prefilled KV on region bring-up.
Maya (Infra): infra can prefill nodes during deployment window, but two blockers: 1) limited cross-region bandwidth quota for large models; 2) orchestration to ensure both regions have same model version at cutover.
Raj (Security): also callout: cross-region data residency rules for this customer disallow logs with PII leaving region. We must ensure audit shipper filters PII and that KMS keys are region-bound.
Tess (Observability): to validate failover RTO<30s we need two new checks: region-heartbeat and prefix-cache-hit-rate. I can instrument those quickly but need schema for events and a dashboard.
Aria (PM): acceptance checklist proposal: (A) active-active deployment validated in staging with synthetic failover <=30s, (B) KV prefill/consistency plan, (C) per-region KMS + audit filter, (D) canary run 24h with traffic ramp to 20%. Agree?
Noah (Eng): add quality guard: semantic similarity delta <1.5% on canonical prompt set after prefill. If prefill changes tokenization/glue behavior we must rollback.
Chen (Runtime): rough estimates: code changes for region-prefetch + reconcile logic = 2 eng-weeks. Prefill tooling + orchestration hooks = 1 eng-week. We'll need infra to give us test quota for two full-sized model copies.
Maya (Infra): Test quota: we have a small window May 18-20 where spare capacity exists for staging. For production pilot we'd need finance approval for multi-region reserved GPUs. I'll file the capacity request today.
Raj (Security): For KMS region-bound keys, vendor needs key policy updates. Legal signoff required for data residency addendum. ETA 10 business days once PO sent.
Tess (Observability): I'll prototype the dashboard and alert rules by EOD Fri. Will post a link to a staging dashboard then.
Aria (PM): Decisions: 1) Make per-region KMS & PII-filtering a launch gate. 2) Approve 24h 20% canary after staging pass. 3) Prioritize prefill tooling in this sprint. Owners: Noah -> runtime code, Maya -> capacity request, Raj -> legal/KMS intake, Tess -> dashboard.
OpsBot: scheduled job: staging/prefill-run queued for 2026-05-18 02:00 UTC (depends on infra capacity approval).
Noah (Eng): I'll open a small ADR for the consistency model (eventual+TTL) and link the rollback plan. PR by Wed.
Aria (PM): Great. Reconvene Tues 9am PT to check staging prefill metrics and go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
